source.quote: MUSICIAN Audio Technology's own page for the Pegasus III, read 2026-11-25 with curl, the site being HTTP-only. « DSD / 1. All inputs support DSD64 DoP / 2. USB and I2S inputs support DSD1024 »; « PCM / 1. All inputs support 24bit/192KHz / 2. USB/I2S input supports 1536 kHz »; « 7. USB/I2S input all supports DSD1024, PCM up to 1536kHz (Audio source must be compatible with this unit's interface) ». « Significant upgrades have been made to the internal architecture, optimizing the circuit and improving the R2R architecture. This machine is equipped with a fully balanced R2R circuit, high-speed multi-channel digital isolators, multiple sets of R2R array resistors and triggers, achieving precise D/A conversion, improving sound quality, and offering higher cost-effectiveness. »; « Features / 1. Exclusive R2R+DSD architecture / 2. Low thermal effect, high-precision manual matching of 0.1% resistors / 3. TCXO Crystal 45.1548MHz, 49.152MHz / 4. Low-noise power supply / 5. FIFO Buffer / 6. Digital Signal Processing via FPGA / 8. Proprietary USB audio via MCU based on STM32F446 advanced ARM architecture solution / 9. No drivers required on Mac and Linux »; « The crystal oscillator has been upgraded with two directly inserted full-size high-precision customized crystal oscillators ». ABSENT from this page's text: no NOS/OS statement, no ladder bit depth, no FIR filter statement, no digital input list, no analogue output spec, no dimensions. Most of the page is a single JPEG, 1110 x 24864 px and 10.3 MB, from which no figure was read.

facts.chip: « a fully balanced R2R circuit, high-speed multi-channel digital isolators, multiple sets of R2R array resistors and triggers, achieving precise D/A conversion » - the sentence binds the ladder to the conversion, so this is a genuine discrete-ladder claim. « high-precision manual matching of 0.1% resistors », against 0.005% on the Aquarius and Taurus - a per-model difference, not a conflict. FPGA for « Digital Signal Processing », USB via « STM32F446 ». No part number, and none exists anywhere on the site.

_conditions_NON_CONCLUANTES_chez_MUSICIA: No terms page found on musician-audio.com, so no prohibition could be checked - which is NOT the same as finding no prohibition. Measured 2026-11-25: every footer link on both the English and Chinese sites was read (About Us, News, Contact Us, Technical Support, Related Downloads, After-sales Policy), EVERY live column page was enumerated (col.jsp ids 103, 104, 105, 106, 114, 115, 121, 123, 124, 125, 132, 134, 139, 142, 144, 147, 150, 157, 160, 163) and swept for copyright, reproduc, reprint, all rights, intellectual propert, without permission, 版权, 禁止, 转载 and 未经. The only hit on any page was the footer: « ©2026 musician copyright » in English, « ©2026 musician 版权所有 » in Chinese. /en/terms.jsp, /en/terms, /en/legal, /en/privacy and /en/tos all 404. robots.txt is 404 on both hosts, so no Content-Signal and no Claude group exist - because the file does not exist - and no X-Robots-Tag header is sent.
_le_domaine_musicianaudio_com_NEST_PAS_l: A trap that would have produced a false policy. musicianaudio.com is a GoDaddy PARKED domain - nameservers NS39/NS40.DOMAINCONTROL.COM, a 114-byte JavaScript redirect to /lander, and a sitemap containing that single URL. It nonetheless serves a plausible robots.txt with « LLM-Policy: /llms.txt », and that llms.txt reads « Disallow-Training: / ». THAT BELONGS TO THE PARKING SERVICE, NOT TO MUSICIAN, and recording it as the maker's policy would have invented a refusal out of a registrar's default page. The maker's own site is musician-audio.com, HTTP ONLY - no HTTPS listener on either host, so a fetcher that upgrades to HTTPS cannot reach it at all, and the server returns gzip regardless of Accept-Encoding. musicianhifi.com is also not the maker: it is a Hong Kong dealer.
_le_tableau_par_entree_de_MUSICIAN_le_pl: « 24bits / 44.1, 48, 88.2, 96, 176.4, 192KHz On All Input » and « 1536kHz On USB & I2S Input »; « DSD64-DoP On All Input » and « DSD1024 On USB & I2S Input ». EIGHT TIMES the PCM rate and sixteen times the DSD rate between the USB and I2S pair and every other socket - the widest per-input gap in the whole catalogue, and stated per socket by the maker rather than inferred. 1536 kHz is also the highest PCM ceiling the base holds, and DSD1024 the highest DSD. A consumer's engine that read a device figure of 1536 kHz and sent it down the AES socket would be eight times over.
_le_DoP_est_dit_et_le_NATIF_ne_lest_PAS: « DSD64-DoP On All Input » names the transport explicitly, so `dop` is true. But « DSD1024 On USB & I2S Input » names none, and the only occurrence of the word native on the page is in the caveat « the audio source needs to be compatible with the native interface » - which is about the socket, not the DSD stream. So `native_dsd` is ABSENT: the maker has not said whether DSD1024 over USB arrives native or framed. On a discrete ladder with a separate 6-bit DSD path that is the one thing a reader would most want to know.
_AUCUN_mode_NOS_nest_dit_sur_cette_page_: The original Pegasus, the Aquarius and the Taurus all state « Sampling Mode: Non-Oversampling NOS / Oversampling OS » in those words. This page, the current flagship, does NOT - and the only NOS text on it is the site-wide Chinese block headed « Aquarius » that also appears on a power amplifier and a pair of loudspeakers. So `correctable` is ABSENT here, on a device that very probably has the mode. That is the cost of the rule and it is the right cost: the alternative is writing the catalogue's most consequential field from a template. The maker publishes « User's Manual for PEGASUS III.pdf » at col.jsp?id=105, which would almost certainly settle it.
